intro.title: Internal component library
intro.description: Internal catalogue for reusable layouts, components, and case-study modules.
intro.note: This route is intentionally not linked in primary navigation.

foundations.name: Design tokens and global CSS
foundations.purpose: Defines shared spacing, radius, colors, and typography for components.
foundations.whenToUse: Use these tokens and base classes before adding one-off values in components.

props.name: .container / .section / .prose
props.notes: Use for predictable page structure and readable text width.

examples:
/* in main.css */
:root { --space-md: 2rem; --radius-md: 16px; }
…
foundations.previewNote: Foundations are global primitives and are best reviewed in code + live page context.

layouts.name: layouts/base.njk
layouts.purpose: Global page shell with site header, footer, and main content.
layouts.whenToUse: Default layout for normal pages unless a page needs a custom wrapper.

props.name: title
props.notes: Used in the document title and page heading contexts.

examples:
---
layout: layouts/base.njk
title: Example page
---
layouts.previewNote: Layout wrappers are page-level composition and not rendered inline here.

layouts.name: layouts/case-study.njk
layouts.purpose: Renders case-study modules based on module.type values.
layouts.whenToUse: Use for work detail pages that assemble content from modules.

props.name: modules[]
props.notes: Each module must include a supported type.

examples:
modules:
  - type: "hero"
  - type: "projectSnapshot"
  - type: "decisionBlock"
layouts.previewNote: Preview module output in the Case study modules section below.

cards.name: card.njk
cards.purpose: Case-study summary card for home and work indexes.
cards.whenToUse: Use for clickable work cards with optional media and tags.

props.name: card.showMediaPlaceholder
props.notes: Displays placeholder block when image is missing.

examples:
{% set card = { url: '/work/example/', theme: 'sky', data: { title: 'Title' } } %}
{% include "components/card.njk" %}

cards.name: about-card.njk
cards.purpose: Flexible content card used in About and Speaking sections.
cards.whenToUse: Use for short narrative cards, with optional image and optional link.

props.name: card.placeholderImage
props.notes: Optional fallback image path when no card.image is set.

examples:
{% set card = { title: 'Title', description: 'Copy' } %}
{% include "components/about-card.njk" %}

card.title: About card rich
card.description: Image, copy, and optional link rendered.

card.title: About card minimal
card.description: No custom image or link; uses placeholder asset in component-library preview.

cards.name: testimonial-card.njk
cards.purpose: Simple testimonial card for quote + optional role.
cards.whenToUse: Use when you only need testimonial quote text and an optional role line.
examples:
{% set testimonial = { quote: 'Great work', role: 'Design Lead' } %}
{% include "components/testimonial-card.njk" %}

testimonial.quote: Strong systems thinking and clear communication.

globalComponents.name: card-grid.njk
globalComponents.purpose: Variant-driven grid wrapper for speaking topic and talk cards.
globalComponents.whenToUse: Use in Speaking pages to render either topic cards or talk cards.

props.name: items
props.notes: List rendered by the chosen variant.

talkItems.title: Talk card one
talkItems.description: Talk cards render through about-card component.

talkItems.title: Talk card two
talkItems.description: This one spans full width on medium layouts.

globalComponents.name: testimonial-grid.njk
globalComponents.purpose: Grid wrapper that renders testimonial-card for each item.
globalComponents.whenToUse: Use when you already have testimonialItems data and want the standard testimonial grid.

props.name: testimonialItems[]
props.notes: Each item supports quote, optional role, optional variant.

examples:
{% set testimonialItems = testimonials.aboutPage %}
{% include "components/testimonial-grid.njk" %}

modules.name: processSection.njk
modules.purpose: Process / steps block with numbered 1-2-3-4 style progression.
modules.whenToUse: Use for storytelling sections where you need to explain a multi-step approach or delivery sequence.
examples:
- type: "processSection"
  title: "How we worked"
  steps:
    - title: "Map the current state"
      body: "Captured handoffs and constraints."

steps.title: Map the current state
steps.body: Captured handoffs and dependencies across teams.

steps.title: Align decision criteria
steps.body: Agreed success measures and constraints with stakeholders.

steps.title: Test options
steps.body: Ran structured reviews to compare solution directions.

steps.title: Lock delivery path
steps.body: Finalized priorities, ownership, and rollout sequence.

modules.name: metricRow.njk
modules.purpose: Metrics row for concise numbers + labels storytelling evidence.
modules.whenToUse: Use for 3-4 headline outcomes or performance indicators in case studies.
examples:
- type: "metricRow"
  title: "Outcomes"
  metrics:
    - value: "3"
      label: "workstreams aligned"

sample.title: Outcomes snapshot
sample.caption: Indicative metrics for this case-study pattern.

modules.notes: This is an existing module used in case studies; documented as the canonical metrics pattern.

modules.name: decisionBlock.njk
modules.purpose: Decision card grid for key choices and rationale.
modules.whenToUse: Use in case studies to capture important decisions with optional status tags.

props.name: module.decisions[]
props.notes: Each card row in the decision grid.

examples:
- type: "decisionBlock"
  title: "Key decisions"
  decisions:
    - title: "Scope boundary"
      body: "Defined what ships first."

modules.name: projectSnapshot.njk
modules.purpose: Metadata List module for compact project facts.
modules.whenToUse: Use for key-value facts (client, scope, timeline). Not intended for large comparison tables.
examples:
- type: "projectSnapshot"
  title: "Project snapshot"
  items:
    - label: "Client"
      value: "Sample client"
modules.notes: Best for compact facts, not comparison tables or large tabular datasets.

modules.name: imageText.njk
modules.purpose: Split layout module for image + text storytelling blocks.
modules.whenToUse: Use when you need a balanced narrative block with supporting visual and optional reversed layout.

props.name: module.paragraphs[] or module.body
props.notes: Structured paragraphs or legacy HTML body.

props.name: module.image
props.notes: Image source object or string path.

props.name: module.imageFrame
props.notes: Set false for bare image variant.

examples:
- type: "imageText"
  heading: "Service framing"
  paragraphs:
    - "Shared understanding first"
  layout: "image-right"

sample.heading: Split layout example (reversed)
paragraphs: This sample documents the image + text split layout.
Set layout to image-right for the reversed variant.

modules.name: mediaFigure.njk
modules.purpose: Full-width visual block with optional caption/supporting text.
modules.whenToUse: Use for standalone visuals that need emphasis between text-heavy modules.

props.name: module.alt
props.notes: Fallback alt when image is string.

props.name: module.holder
props.notes: Wrap image in holder frame style.

examples:
- type: "mediaFigure"
  image: "/assets/images/example.png"
  caption: "Optional supporting text"

sample.caption: Example of a full-width visual block with caption.

modules.name: callout.njk
modules.whenToUse: Use to punctuate narrative sections with a key takeaway.
examples:
- type: "callout"
  tone: "brand"
  text: "Shared decisions reduce delivery risk."

sample.label: Key point
sample.text: Shared decision criteria reduced ambiguity and rework across teams.

modules.name: reflectionBlock.njk
modules.purpose: Narrative reflection module with optional bullets and embedded media.
modules.whenToUse: Use for portfolio storytelling sections where context and reflection matter.

props.name: module.paragraphs[] or module.body
props.notes: Structured paragraph array or legacy body HTML.

props.name: module.media
props.notes: Optional embedded media with image and alt.

examples:
- type: "reflectionBlock"
  title: "Reflection"
  paragraphs:
    - "What worked"
    - "What changed"

sample.title: Reflection sample
paragraphs: Structured reflection content keeps narrative sections readable.
Use bullets where concise takeaways are clearer.
bullets: Decision quality improved with shared criteria.

modules.name: hero.njk
modules.purpose: Case-study hero with title, summary, and tags.
modules.whenToUse: Use as the opening module for each case study.
examples:
- type: "hero"
  heading: "Case headline"
  subheading: "Short summary"

sample.heading: Case-study hero example
sample.subheading: A compact opening block for context, scope, and orientation.

modules.name: two-column-content.njk
modules.purpose: Two-column narrative block for side-by-side context, problem, role, or comparison copy.
modules.whenToUse: Use when your story benefits from paired left/right text blocks such as problem and role.

props.name: module.variant
props.notes: Optional value cards renders bordered card columns.

examples:
- type: "two-column-content"
  left:
    title: "Problem"
    body: "Complex handoffs caused delays."
  right:
    title: "My role"
    body: "I facilitated alignment and decision framing."

left.title: Problem
left.body: Decision ownership was fragmented across teams and handoffs were unclear.
items: Cross-team dependencies were hidden in separate artefacts.
Delivery priorities drifted without explicit decision criteria.

right.title: Role
right.body: I aligned stakeholders on decision criteria and sequencing.
items: Translated outcomes into implementable service decisions.

left.title: Problem
left.body: Use this only when stronger visual separation is needed.

modules.name: process-timeline.njk
modules.purpose: Compact phase timeline module for process overviews and jump links.
modules.whenToUse: Use before deeper sections to show the sequence of phases.

props.name: module.showCircle
props.notes: Toggle circular number marker on or off.

props.name: module.sticky
props.notes: Enables sticky in-page phase nav behavior.

examples:
- type: "process-timeline"
  items:
    - number: "01"
      title: "Frame"
      href: "#phase-frame"

modules.name: sticky-section-nav.njk
modules.purpose: Sticky in-page navigation for long case studies.
modules.whenToUse: Use in long case studies with clear section anchors.
examples:
- type: "sticky-section-nav"
  items:
    - label: "Overview"
      href: "#overview"

modules.name: visual-block.njk
modules.purpose: Simple image + caption visual block with controllable width size.
modules.whenToUse: Use for primary visuals where you need quick size control (full, wide, contained).
examples:
- type: "visual-block"
  image: "/assets/images/example.png"
  imageAlt: "Diagram"
  size: "wide"

modules.name: image-strip.njk
modules.purpose: Horizontal multi-image strip for visual progression or evidence snapshots.
modules.whenToUse: Use when a sequence of related visuals is clearer than a single figure.
examples:
- type: "image-strip"
  images:
    - src: "/assets/images/one.png"
      alt: "Step one visual"

modules.name: insight-grid.njk
modules.purpose: Grid of insight cards for concise findings and implications.
modules.whenToUse: Use after research/process sections to summarize key insights.

props.name: module.variant
props.notes: Optional value cards renders bordered card items.

examples:
- type: "insight-grid"
  items:
    - title: "Constraint visibility"
      body: "Teams made faster choices when trade-offs were explicit."

modules.name: mermaid-diagram.njk
modules.purpose: Mermaid diagram block for process/system relationships.
modules.whenToUse: Use when flow, dependencies, or architecture are better shown as a diagram.
examples:
- type: "mermaid-diagram"
  title: "Decision flow"
  code: |
    flowchart LR
      Start --> Review
      Review --> Decide

sample.title: Decision flow
sample.description: Simple example diagram for module preview.
sample.code:
flowchart LR
  Discovery --> Alignment
  Alignment --> Decisions
  Decisions --> Delivery
sample.caption: Mermaid diagram example.

cta.name: cta.njk
cta.purpose: Reusable call-to-action block matching the speaking style by default.
cta.whenToUse: Use at the end of pages/sections for a clear next action.

props.name: cta.variant
props.notes: Use ink for the legacy dark style.

examples:
{% set cta = { title: 'Need support?', body: 'Optional text', buttonLabel: 'Email', href: 'mailto:test@example.com' } %}
{% include "components/cta.njk" %}

cta.title: Open to opportunities
cta.body: If you are running a session, event, or workshop and want something practical, grounded, and based on real delivery work, I would be glad to collaborate.

cta.title: Need help shaping a service?
cta.body: We can run a short framing sprint and produce delivery-ready artefacts.
